column3: With respect to the 105 Rogers Avenue Mortgage Loan (0.9%), the borrower sponsors disclosed that they are defendants in a pending lawsuit alleging breach of contract, breach of warranty, fraud, negligent misrepresentation, fraudulent conveyances and wrongful distribution of assets arising from their construction, sale, management and marketing of a condominium building in Brooklyn, New York, which is unrelated to the Mortgaged Property. The plaintiff condominium board seeks $2,500,000 in damages or such greater amount as may be established at trial. The borrower sponsor reported that a jury trial is scheduled for January 18, 2027, and a mediation session was scheduled for January 27, 2026. The borrower sponsors reported that an insurer-retained engineer estimated maximum potential damages of $190,500, which the borrower sponsors state is within their available insurance coverage. The borrower sponsors have a combined reported net worth and liquidity of $28.1 million and $3.4 million, respectively.
